title: One query surface: text search + vector search
description:
Milestone 5 of the Local Store Initiative: the press release's "searchable" — one query interface, two engines beneath it, neither visible. Lexical: FTS5 over message texts. Semantic: sqlite-vec vec0 k-NN over 384-dim session embeddings produced at ingest through an `Embedder` seam — a deterministic stub embedder for the specs now; the real all-MiniLM-L6-v2/tract model is the deferred MiniLM epic after this one. Hybrid ranking merges both paths into one ranked result. A store opened without an embedder answers text search normally and semantic search with a clean empty result; stores never mix embedding models. Turns `07_text_search.feature` and `08_vector_search.feature` green.

Every task in this epic: work in your own worktree off origin/develop (unique path, e.g. /tmp/botspy-<task-id>-<short>), branch `feat/store-<short>`, PR to develop only — never main (GitFlow). Log milestone comments on the task; close only when its DoD is met. Gates: cargo fmt --all; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings; RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps; cargo test and cargo test --test bdd. All existing suites stay green (features/01_structure, features/03_importers, features/04_examples, features/cli).
